before_after.description_after:
4-Layer Zinc Alloy Herb Grinder with Storage Chamber

A four-piece manual grinder for wholesale buyers. Its zinc alloy body combines a grinding section, fine screen, collection chamber and lower storage compartment.

Key Features

  • Four-layer threaded construction for grinding, screening, collection and storage.
  • Zinc alloy body with textured grip edges and a fine screen.
  • 40 mm, 50 mm, 55 mm, 63 mm and 75 mm size options.

Product Structure

The threaded sections include the grinding plate, fine screen, collection chamber and lower storage compartment.
